subject: A trial can change the brief.
preheader: Keep what works. Investigate the part that still needs an answer.
intro: You might find that the mattress feels right, but the bed base leaves too little room for the hoist. Or the setup works for the person, while making it harder for their partner to help.
A trial can reveal a more specific question than the one you started with.
body: That feedback gives us something practical to work on together: a different base, another mattress option, or a configuration question to take back to the supplier.

At Sleep Choice, we help organise seven-night bed and mattress trials at home and work through equipment alternatives alongside you. You bring the clinical judgement. We help with the product questions, options and arrangements.
actionLead: Reply with a few de-identified lines about what worked, what did not, and the suburb. If there is an option you have already ruled out, include that too.
actionText: Whether the trial was with us or elsewhere, we can discuss what is worth investigating next.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
